title: Verify settlement totals against merchant wallet balances
sqlValidation:
SELECT
    m.id,
    m.merchantName,
    m.walletBalance,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(s.amount),0),2) AS settlementTotal
FROM dbo.Merchants m
LEFT JOIN dbo.Settlements s ON s.merchantId = m.id
GROUP BY m.id, m.merchantName, m.walletBalance
ORDER BY m.id;
sqlExpectedResult: The resulting values are compared with the approved business rule for whether settlements reduce wallet balance.
